summary: A flight that throws after :162/:185-188 is counted answered and stats.inconclusive is never bumped on any thrown flight; the call returns inconclusive. Fix: bump inconclusive in the catch and defer stats/last_failed/ever_answered writes until the merge copy succeeds.
classification_rationale: metrics misattribute the outcome; residual of sg-1 after its floor part closed

trigger: none (comment)
summary: Comment says the host-vet pool is 'this provider's own (cap 8)'; the fix's comment at :967 and the code make it process-wide and shared across provider re-inits. Fix: reword :1097 to match :967.
classification_rationale: comment contradicts code; architect and unhappy-path concurred after being shown it

trigger: added doc text
summary: Shared-discovery-cache sentence says the timeout is the configured DNS timeout 'to the millisecond' next to the host-vet sentence without noting the host check is whole seconds. Fix: append '(the host-name check still uses whole seconds)'.
classification_rationale: residual phrasing after dw-1 fix

trigger: added row text
summary: Stray space in 'IPv6 destinations .' in the NAT64 row. Fix: remove it.
classification_rationale: typo

trigger: fix rewrote banner at :20-22
summary: Banner says a stuck/busy resolver stays inconclusive 'classified without the learned set'; every inconclusive path (:178-182, :285-288, :308-309) returns the learned set. A maintainer aligning code to comment would reintroduce fail-open. Fix: 'classified with the learned set as it stood, or refused if overflowed'.
classification_rationale: comment contradicts code next to a security-relevant branch; unhappy-path concurred after being shown it

trigger: fix's CRL-text removal at :25-26
summary: Banner reads '...(its historical behaviour), the a consumer that gates admission...' - broken sentence. Fix: '; a consumer that gates admission may instead refuse with a retryable error.'
classification_rationale: raised independently by cpp-expert and architect in the same Gate 3 wave

trigger: unjoined detached test worker reads namespace-scope static during static destruction
summary: Worker lambdas build results from global kPref1; in the test at :370-391 a 300ms worker outlives the 40ms leader and nothing drains the pool, so a single-test run exiting inside that window could read a destroyed string. 5 single-test ASan runs did not reproduce. Fix: capture a copy or drain the pool.
classification_rationale: test-only lifetime hazard

trigger: operator reads the stuck-resolver runbook/upgrade note on a Windows server
summary: Runbook and upgrading.md:15 say a pinned yuzu_server_oidc_resolver_in_flight==8 signals a stuck host check; on Windows the vet keeps GetAddrInfoExW (oidc_provider.cpp:969, :1006-1008), the pool stays idle and the gauge reads 0. Fix: scope to Linux/macOS and name the Windows signal (abandoned-request ledger).
classification_rationale: doc false on one platform; enterprise-readiness (g8-er-1) and unhappy-path echoed it after being shown

trigger: upgrade reader hits NAT64 overflow
summary: Overflow bullet ends 'Declare the real prefix with --oidc-nat64-prefix.' while upgrading.md:15, server-admin.md:5884, the log text and changelog say the flag does not clear overflow; following it leaves IPv6 OIDC refused (fails visibly). Fix: 'Fix the resolver and restart; --oidc-nat64-prefix does not clear overflow.' Orchestrator confirmed the sentence with sed.
classification_rationale: raised independently in the Gate 4 wave by happy-path, unhappy-path (up-9 residual) and consistency-auditor (co-2 residual); enterprise-readiness (g8-er-2, I7/SHOULD) echoed after being shown. severity_mapped recorded at the stronger SHOULD label from enterprise-readiness; derived band from I8/E3 is LOW (over-label kept deliberately)

trigger: branch moved OIDC host vet off httplib's resolver
summary: Still says the POSIX resolver is capped where httplib's non-blocking resolver is compiled in (Linux only); HEAD uses bounded_resolve in the 8-slot pool on Linux+macOS and fails closed when full. Fix: rewrite the clause.
classification_rationale: architecture doc made false by this change

trigger: run_flight throws and the catch's copy also throws
summary: Inner catch sets overflowed=true: caller gets the overflow reason while the gauge reads 0 and no overflow log/counter fires, pointing the operator at a needless restart. Fail-closed outcome is correct. Fix: distinct internal-error reason or counter.
classification_rationale: misleading signal on a fail-closed path

trigger: throw at the merge after ever_answered/last_failed were written
summary: Cache reports 'answered' holding none of that answer's prefixes; the catch now forwards the flag. No current consumer gates on it. Fix: build merged before mutating cache state (same root as g8-sg-1).
classification_rationale: state ordering; sibling of g8-sg-1 (metrics half)

trigger: hostile/broken resolver overflows some replicas' process-local caches
summary: IPv6 sign-in success depends on LB routing; a callback landing on an overflowed replica fails mid-flow; a rolling restart is re-filled by the same resolver; restart is the only remedy. Fix: per-replica overflow alert and a 'fix resolver first, restart only the affected replica' runbook step.
classification_rationale: operational gap beyond sre6-2's guidance gap

trigger: throwing leader while overflowed with concurrent waiters
summary: Closure test covers a single caller only; code read shows waiters also refuse, but no test locks it. Fix: chaos CH-G8-1 as a unit test (4-8 waiters + throwing leader).
classification_rationale: test gap; derived INFO from I9/E5, native SHOULD recorded

trigger: every lookup throws under sustained memory pressure
summary: A thrown flight writes no negative TTL, so every IPv6 check starts a real lookup; bounded by the cap-1 single flight.
classification_rationale: wasteful but bounded

trigger: evidence traceability
summary: Review doc and changelog say 'later features also read' and name a CRL source registry/fetcher as a future consumer with no anchor; may read as a shipped CRL claim. Fix: 'no other consumer today; a future consumer adds its own section'.
classification_rationale: forward-looking prose

trigger: host-vet pool pinned on an SSO-only deployment
summary: Isolation paragraph says every OIDC fetch to a named host is refused and to fix the resolver and restart, without the operator-lockout consequence or /readyz posture. Extends sre6-3.
classification_rationale: runbook gap

trigger: resolver stress on an SSO-only deployment after upgrade

trigger: sharing the review doc with a customer
summary: Doc and changelog carry the ledger path, 'review point 3' with no referent, the forward CRL consumer and the Windows-CI merge condition. Fix: move them to the PR body.
